summary: Bit Origin Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 9, 2026, furnishing a press release that provides a corporate update on its AI strategy execution and governance initiatives. The press release describes post-closing activities following AI infrastructure agreements, including equipment delivery coordination and deployment. No specific transaction, terms, or shareholder vote are mentioned. This is a routine business update with no special-situation event.
